Der NDR erteilt gegebenenfalls konkrete Vollmachten, damit der Auftragnehmer den NDR bei der Beschaffung der Genehmigung vertreten kann. 7 Schadensverhütung vor Ort (vgl. §§ 4 und 10 VOL/B) 7.1 Der Auftragnehmer ist verpflichtet, die staatlichen Arbeits- schutz- und Unfallverhütungsvorschriften sowie die all- gemein anerkannten sicherheitstechnischen und arbeits- medizinischen Regeln in vollem Umfang zu erfüllen. Der Auftragnehmer hat auf Anforderung des NDR einen entsprechenden Nachweis zu führen. Der Auftragnehmer sichert zu, dass die zu liefernden Geräte – soweit anwendbar – die grundlegenden Anforderungen der CE- Zertifizierung der Europäischen Union erfüllen und entsprechend gekennzeichnet sind. 7.2 Bei elektrischen Geräten und stromführenden Objekten (wie z.B. mobile Verteiler und Verlängerungskabel), die von Dienstleistern bzw. Auftragnehmern als notwendige Arbeitsmittel mit in Betriebsstätten des NDR gebracht werden, hat der Auftragnehmer eigenständig sicherzu- stellen, dass diese nach Maßgabe der DGUV Vorschrift 3 geprüft sind und damit betriebssicher eingesetzt werden können. Weiter gewährleistet der Auftragnehmer in eige- ner Verantwortlichkeit die Einhaltung der Betriebssicher- heitsverordnung in Bezug auf alle mitgebrachten Arbeitsmittel.

Enclosed please find the Request for Quotation (RFQ) package, including the proposed technical specifications, for the Procurement of Printing Services for the U.S. Embassy in Hanoi, covering the period November 2026 to December 2030. If you would like to submit a quotation, please complete the required portions of the attached document and submit it to the address indicated on the Standard Form 18 included with this letter. Your submission must include the following: - Standard Form 18: Complete blocks 11e & 11f (Price), and blocks 13, 14, 15 and 16 (Bidder’s information) - Pricing: As per RFQ Section C - Technical Proposal: As required in RFQ - NDAA certification Your quotation must be submitted electronically to HanoiGSOProcurement

Answers from the Embassy will be issued no later than October 15, 2026 local time. The U.S. Government intends to establish the Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) with the responsible offerors submitting the lowest-priced, technically acceptable quotation that meets all solicitation requirements. Purpose This Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) is a Government developed and applied document used to ensure the systematic Quality Assurance (QA) methods are used in the administration surveillance of tasking under the Contract. The intent is to ensure the Contractor performs In Accordance With (IAW) the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and the Government receives the quality of services called for in the FFP contract. The Contractor shall deliver fully operational, integrated, and sustained EW SITE systems and sub-system components for domestic and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. The required outcome is an EW SITE system capable of supporting a multitude of laboratory-specific System Configurations across multiple platforms (EA-18G, F/A-18, MH-60) while maintaining configuration consistency with the Advanced Weapons Laboratory (AWL) at NAWCWD China Lake, CA. Additionally, the Contractor shall ensure continuous operational readiness of current EW SITE systems through comprehensive lifecycle support, including on-call and on-site maintenance, system upgrades, replacement parts provisioning, and personnel training. This Contract will have FFP CLINs. The Contract will have a five-year period of performance. A properly executed QASP will assist the Government in achieving the objectives of this procurement. 2. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

deliverables_scope.text: ..................... ................................ ........ 6 6 Kreditering ................................ ................................ ................................ ..... 6 1 Krav om elektronisk fakturering I medhold av Forskrift om elektronisk faktura i offentlige anskaffelser (2.april 2019) er EHF faktura obligatorisk ved fakturering til kommunene. All fakturering til Harstad kommune og samarbeidskommuner som inngår i kontrakten, må gjennomføres i Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF). Godkjente standardformater er EHF fakturering versjon 3.0 eller nyere og PEPPOL BIS (PEPPOL Business Interoperability Specification) Billing v3.0 eller nyere. Dette dokumentet omfatter bestemmelser om hvordan elektronisk fakturering gjennomføres for Harstad kommune med samarbeidskommuner, i EHF-formatet. Dokumentet beskriver kun de spesifikke informasjonselementene kommunene sender og har behov for å motta fra leverandøren. Obligatorisk innhold i EHF3.0 omhandles ikke i denne spesifikasjonen, slik som virksomhetsadresser, mva. håndtering, kontoopplysninger og lignende. For en mer omfattende veiledning for Elektronisk Handels Format (EHF) v3.0, se: Elektronisk Handelsformat - EHF - Prosessdefinisjoner | Anskaffelser.no Spesifikasjon av felter og innhold er i
